description: This file defines the VacancyDao class, which interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations and queries related to job vacancies in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: VacancyDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing vacancy-related database operations within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of vacancies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getVacancyListPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for the vacancy list based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getVacanciesQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a Doctrine QueryBuilder with conditions based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: saveJobVacancy
methods.description: Saves a vacancy entity to the database.

methods.name: getVacanciesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of vacancies matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getVacancyById
methods.description: Fetches a vacancy by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of existing vacancies from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getHiringManagerEmpNumberList
methods.description: Lists hiring manager employee numbers for vacancies matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getVacancyIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all vacancy IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Returns vacancy IDs for a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if an employee number belongs to a hiring manager with current vacancies.

methods.name: isActiveJobTitle
methods.description: Checks if a JobTitle ID corresponds to an active (not deleted) job title.

methods.name: isActiveHiringManger
methods.description: Checks if an employee is an active hiring manager (exists and no termination record).
